description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the I18NImportErrorAPI class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. Specifically, it tests the API endpoints related to internationalization import errors, including retrieval and handling of such errors in the admin API context.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the I18NImportErrorAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating specific database tables and populating fixture data.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' endpoint of the I18NImportErrorAPI to ensure it retrieves multiple import error records correctly.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetAll' method from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the create method in the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that the validation rules for creation are not implemented and throw the expected exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that delete operation in the API is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for delete are not implemented.
